race.description: Wests Illawarra - Your Next Stop Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: UNHINGED (6) improving colt with his hoof on the till. Relished the extra ground with a fighting on-pace second over 1550m at Randwick Kensington in a Super Maiden. Can build on that latest effort in a winnable race. I AM DYNASTY (8) justified the good support on debut with a solid on-speed second over 1300m at this track. Has a ton of upside and can hold a position from the sticky gate. Go close. COTOLETTA CUT (9) has shown plenty of grit in his two career starts. Stalked the speed at the big odds with a respectable third over 1550m at Randwick Kensington in a Super Maiden. Doesn't have to improve much to get the better of these. CLOUDY SCOUT (15) Trapeze Artist filly from Lady Marvel on debut for the Richard & Will Freedman yard. Won a Rosehill trial over 900m on September 8 in good style. Respect.
